free.q: What do I get for free?
free.a: A few live exams every month and some practice questions every day. Premium unlocks everything.

device.q: How many devices can I use?
device.a: One at a time. Logging in on a new device signs out the old one.

payment.a: With bKash or a card (SSLCommerz). Your package starts as soon as the payment goes through.

offline.q: What if the internet drops during an exam?
offline.a: Your answers are saved on the device and sync on their own when you are back online.
